integrity: All claimed universal identities have an analytic proof. Symbolic and finite numerical checks are corroborative only. Public source citations are of actual literature and are not proof of complete bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Fixed pure degree-two spherical harmonic subspace; disjoint-interior equal caps centered at regular-simplex vertices; no spectra for overlapping masks, degree sums, arbitrary centres or noisy discrete sampling. Historical priority could be affected by an equivalent unlocated formula.
title: Two-band quadratic Slepian spectrum for simplex-centred cap masks and an isolated tetrahedral isotropy
